title: 군대 휴가
scene: 민준 첫 휴가. 치킨집에서 만나기로 했는데
goal: A friend's first leave from the army

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 야, 나 휴가 나왔어! 치킨 냄새 벌써 나네.
turns.rd: ya, na hyuga nawasseo! chikin naemsae beolsseo nane.
turns.en: Hey, I'm on leave! I can already smell the chicken.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 헐 민준아. 머리 완전 짧아졌어. 군인 티 팍 나.
turns.rd: heol minjuna. meori wanjeon jjalbajyeosseo. gunin ti pak na.
turns.en: Whoa Minjun. Your hair's completely short. You look totally military.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Yeah I'm a soldier. More importantly, did you order? Hungry.

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 응 세 마리. 너 다 먹을 거 같아서.
turns.rd: eung se mari. neo da meogeul geo gataseo.
turns.en: Yeah three. Figured you'd eat them all yourself.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: …Thanks for the letters. Kept reading them… I missed you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Really? I made a lot of mistakes in Korean, right?

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 응. 그래서 더 웃겼어. 다 외웠다니까.
turns.rd: eung. geuraeseo deo utgyeosseo. da oewotdanikka.
turns.en: Yeah. That's why they were even funnier. I memorized all of them, seriously.
